text: Explainability of tree ensembles under correlated features
path_note: Empirical, and the loop already has a harness and sandbox image for a parent problem on this topic (TreeHFD, arXiv 2510.24815). This is the topic carried through the Increment 2 loop end to end. ConOps S4's own example.
good_question: One specific question about whether or how a decomposition or attribution method for tree ensembles stays accurate or stable when features are correlated, small enough to test on public tabular datasets in minutes on a CPU.
status: draft, proposed by the agent; to be approved or edited by Chris at the topics_chosen gate
key_papers_note: Identifiers checked by looking up each arXiv id (arXiv API) and DOI (Crossref DOI endpoint) for its title, first author and year on 2026-10-02. This is a metadata check of the listed papers, not a topic search; no query built from the topic or its question has been run.
